Oct 27 (Reuters) – Private equity giant Advent raised $30 billion across its latest fund complex, the firm said on Tuesday, securing ​capital for a flagship buyout vehicle ‌and a new mid-market strategy, and defying a sluggish exit market.

• Advent raised $27 billion for its 11th global private equity fund, GPE XI, ‌the ​largest buyout fund closed so ⁠far in 2026, the ⁠firm said

• The private equity firm also secured more than $3 billion in commitments for a new mid-market strategy it launched in ​March

• Meanwhile, the mid-market vehicle will use the ⁠same deal ‌teams to invest equity between $100 ⁠million and $350 million in North American ​and ‌European companies with enterprise values of ​up to $1.25 ⁠billion

• The firm secured capital from new and existing investors, including pension funds, sovereign wealth funds, endowments, institutional managers, family offices and high-net-worth individuals

(Reporting by Pritam Biswas in Bengaluru; Editing by ​Vijay Kishore)
